verdict.rationale: Kit ships an official remote MCP server that lets an AI client read live account data: subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments. The V4 API adds rich campaign-results endpoints: per-broadcast stats, batch stats for a page of broadcasts, per-link clicks, 90-day account email stats and growth stats. Together these cover audiences and recent campaign performance well. Missing for 10: evidence that live visual automations (beyond sequences) can be read programmatically, any automation-level performance stats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent assembling such a report.
